title: Retest round — Desk batch (30 tickets)
env: staging-desk.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless, playwright) · main account mahmoud.mahamed1515 (Desk Administrator + CRM Admin); mahmoud.mmohamedsamy (Desk Administrator) for the permission check; QA modules QA RT MF / QA RT Closed / QA RT Closed UI / QA RT xxxx (26 chars)
devNote: 22 of 30 tickets carry one developer comment (21 Oct 11:04–11:10) saying FIXED; 8 have no comment (2246, 2249, 2252, 2253, 2254, 2255, 2259) — 2246 is only partly fixed, the other 7 pass anyway. 2239, 2245, 2258 were verified by the developer in the deployed bundle only.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Profiles chosen in the Create Module dialog are not applied
tickets.devHeld: Held for applying and enforcing; the module is still shown to users who are not allowed.
tickets.summary: Create Module dialog with Module Permission = Desk Administrator → POST 201 + PUT permissions 200, ACL selected. With a module restricted to Desk Agent, a Desk Administrator not on the list gets 403 on reading and creating records, but the module is still in GET /modules and in the "+" create menu.
still: Expected the user outside the permission not to see the module — it is still offered in the "+" menu (clicking leads to 403).

tickets.title: Tickets | Ticket Owner filter lists CRM users alongside Desk agents
tickets.devHeld: Held (the directory now returns 10 Desk users, not 4).
tickets.summary: Ticket Owner filter: Unassigned, Me and the 10 Desk users; no CRM-only users.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Records can be saved without the required Name field
tickets.summary: No name, empty name (POST and PATCH) → 422 Name is required.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Record API ignores single-line max length
tickets.summary: 11 characters in a max-10 field → 422 with a clear message; 10 accepted.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Record API ignores number min/max and accepts text in number fields
tickets.summary: 101, -1, "abc", "15,000" → 422 (POST and PATCH); 50 accepted.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Record API accepts invalid email, phone and javascript: URLs
tickets.summary: Invalid email/phone → 422; javascript:, mixed-case javascript: and data: URLs → 422 (POST and PATCH); valid values accepted.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Record API accepts pick-list values that are not in the list
tickets.summary: Delta → 422 naming the allowed values (POST and PATCH); "beta" normalised to Beta.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Field regex is saved but not enforced
tickets.devHeld: Held through the builder (regex stored on the field).
tickets.summary: Regex set in the builder → ab12 refused (422) on create and update, AB1234 accepted. A regex placed only on the layout entry (old API path) is not enforced.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | A required field can be set to "Don't Show"
tickets.summary: Hidden on a required field → 422 with a clear reason; optional field still hideable. Read-only on the required field is still accepted (same effect for agents) — logged as an observation.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Access Control picker lists CRM users and profiles instead of Desk ones
tickets.summary: Layout Permissions picker: 10 Desk users; profiles Desk Administrator / Agent / Light Agent / Reviewer / Supervisor.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Radio and Status fields accept values that are not in their list
tickets.summary: R9 and Closed → 422; valid values accepted.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | A module can be created with a blank name
tickets.summary: Blank → 400 MODULE_NAME_REQUIRED; 120 chars → 400 MODULE_NAME_TOO_LONG (max 50).

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Rename accepts an empty name or another module's name
tickets.summary: Empty → 400; "Tickets" → 409 MODULE_NAME_TAKEN; name unchanged.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Layout builder → Rename Module crashes the page
tickets.summary: Tickets › Layout settings › Rename Module opens the dialog with values filled; no crash.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Set as default on a layout that holds records returns 500
tickets.summary: Layout with 6 records → set-default 200, and back 200.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Record API accepts invalid dates
Modules and Fields | Record API ignores multi-select max items
tickets.summary: 3 items with max 2 → 422; unknown option → 422.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | A new lookup to Contacts is not registered as a related module
tickets.summary: New lookup QA RT MF → Contacts; Contacts related-modules lists QA RT MF.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Deleted dependency rules come back after Save
tickets.summary: Deleted both rules in the builder → layout stores [] and reload shows "No dependency rules yet".

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Custom data types are listed but cannot be used to create a field (API)
tickets.summary: A field with a custom data type is now accepted (201, was 400), but it is stored with the base type single_line — the custom type is not kept, so nothing ties the field to it.
still: Expected the field to be created with the custom type (qa_rt_dt); actual datatypeKey "single_line".

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Arabic UI leaves "Create New Layout" and the layouts description in English
tickets.summary: In Arabic the button and description are translated; the Layouts table header "Last Modified" is still English.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Module list shows "UN" as last modifier of every seeded module
tickets.summary: "UN" is gone, but the list shows "System" on every module, including Tickets (API: ndc-staging-owner) and QA RT MF (API: mahmoud.mahamed1515).
still: Last Modified must show the real modifier when there is one.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Setup sidebar says "Set up your CRM"
tickets.summary: Sidebar shows "Set up your Desk".

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Two modules can share the same display name
tickets.summary: Same display name with another key → 409 MODULE_NAME_TAKEN (also for "Tickets").

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Layout builder does not warn about a duplicate layout name
tickets.summary: Inline "A layout with this name already exists" while typing; Save disabled.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Field label length (50) not enforced by the API
tickets.summary: 51 characters → 400 FIELD_LABEL_TOO_LONG; 50 accepted.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Two lookups to the same module can use the same related-list title
tickets.devHeld: Held; the original payload used a different key.
tickets.summary: Second lookup with the same related_list_title → 409.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | A multi-module lookup can be saved with no modules
tickets.summary: target_modules [] → 400 LOOKUP_TARGET_MODULES_REQUIRED.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | Two layout-builder buttons have no accessible name
tickets.summary: Module Image switch labelled; 56 icon-only buttons, none without a name.

tickets.title: Modules and Fields | The 512-fields-per-layout limit is not enforced by the API
tickets.summary: Layout PUT with 525 fields → 400 LAYOUT_FIELD_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (answer took 55 s).

observations: Required field can be set read-only for a profile
POST field-permissions name / Desk Agent / read_only → 200; agents then cannot fill a required field (same effect NDC-2228 fixed for hidden).
Restricted module still offered to other profiles
Part of NDC-2220: GET /modules and the "+" menu still list a module the user's profile cannot open.
Part of NDC-2250: every row shows "System".
PUT of a 525-field layout needs 55 s before the 400 (first call timed out at 30 s).
Each builder Save also sends PUT for the module's lookup fields (qa_rt_lk1, qa_rt_lk3) although they were not edited.
Opening a layout URL directly shows an empty "Standard Layout" placeholder for several seconds (also seen on CRM, where a rollup save then did not persist).
One helper error printed a session cookie for mahmoud.mmohamedsamy into the run log; the account was signed in again at once (old session revoked) and all runners now redact cookies.
